title: Comparative Administrative Law I
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the supreme law of the land; it formulates fundamental rights of individuals."
Constitutional law is the supreme law of the land; it formulates fundamental rights of individuals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the more popular view and upon which most states practice the doctrine of separation of powers."
The liberty school is the more popular view and upon which most states practice the doctrine of separation of powers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the first and one of the most important principles of administrative rulemaking."
Notice is the first and one of the most important principles of administrative rulemaking.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the study of the nature, scope, and meaning of moral judgment."
Meta-ethics is the study of the nature, scope, and meaning of moral judgment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a creature of the constitution and is governed by the constitution."
The legislature is a creature of the constitution and is governed by the constitution.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the formal path, established in legislation, which an administrative action should follow."
Administrative rulemaking procedure refers to the formal path, established in legislation, which an administrative action should follow.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined under the APA as "the whole or a part of an agency statement of general or particular applicability and future effect." 5 U.S.C. §551(4)."
A rule is defined under the APA as "the whole or a part of an agency statement of general or particular applicability and future effect." 5 U.S.C. §551(4).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a feature of modern governments which most, if not all governments cannot do without."
Public corporation is a feature of modern governments which most, if not all governments cannot do without.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the Teachers Training Agency, Human Fertilization and Embryonic Authority."
Examples of such bodies are the Teachers Training Agency, Human Fertilization and Embryonic Authority.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is composed of several distinct types of regulatory administrative institutions and various types of entities that are the subjects of regulation, including not only states but also individuals, firms."

The global administrative space is composed of several distinct types of regulatory administrative institutions and various types of entities that are the subjects of regulation, including not only states but also individuals, firms.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as a system in which the laws are public knowledge, are clear in meaning, and apply equally to everyone."
The rule of law can be defined as a system in which the laws are public knowledge, are clear in meaning, and apply equally to everyone.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as the process that determines 'who gets what, when and how' (Lasswell, 1936)."
Politics can be defined as the process that determines 'who gets what, when and how' (Lasswell, 1936).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of formulating a general rule of conduct, without reference to particular cases, and usually operating in the future."
Legislation is the process of formulating a general rule of conduct, without reference to particular cases, and usually operating in the future.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a person at the head of a ministry or department of state and a member of the cabinet."
A Minister in this context is a person at the head of a ministry or department of state and a member of the cabinet.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the process used by administrative agencies to issue regulations through adversary proceedings."
Administrative adjudication refers to the process used by administrative agencies to issue regulations through adversary proceedings.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a set of rules outlining the responsibilities of, or proper practices for, an individual, party or organization."
A code of conduct is a set of rules outlining the responsibilities of, or proper practices for, an individual, party or organization.
fib: ______ is a limited government, whereas most socialist constitutions, although written, do not place limits on what the government can do.
constitutional government
A constitutional government is a limited government, whereas most socialist constitutions, although written, do not place limits on what the government can do.
______ means the description of ethical ideas without presenting an opinion on their rightness.
Descriptive ethics
Descriptive ethics means the description of ethical ideas without presenting an opinion on their rightness.
______ refer to the common law doctrines, either as a way of understanding APA provisions or even as independent sources of limits on agency action.
Courts sometimes still
Courts sometimes still refer to the common law doctrines, either as a way of understanding APA provisions or even as independent sources of limits on agency action.
______ is the bye product of the growing socio-economic functions of the state and the increased powers of the government.
Administrative law
Administrative law is the bye product of the growing socio-economic functions of the state and the increased powers of the government.
______ means the rules and principles regulating the behaviour of individuals.
Ethics
Ethics means the rules and principles regulating the behaviour of individuals.

______ is the machinery through which government designs and implements its policies; it is the organ created to ensure that policies and programmes of any government at any particular time are carried out.
civil service

The civil service is the machinery through which government designs and implements its policies; it is the organ created to ensure that policies and programmes of any government at any particular time are carried out.
______ is the body responsible for the implementation, enforcement and administration of the laws made by the legislative arm of government.
executive
The executive is the body responsible for the implementation, enforcement and administration of the laws made by the legislative arm of government.
______ is the ears of the people because it serves as a mechanism of redressing the grievances of citizens in a political system.
institution
The institution is the ears of the people because it serves as a mechanism of redressing the grievances of citizens in a political system.
______ is an agency of effective public administration.
Ombudsman
The Ombudsman is an agency of effective public administration.
______ are those public servants who are direct employees of both federal and state governments other than the police, armed forces personnel, and the teachers.
Civil servants
Civil servants are those public servants who are direct employees of both federal and state governments other than the police, armed forces personnel, and the teachers.
______ is the head of the executive and acts on the advice of the Council of Ministers.
President
The President is the head of the executive and acts on the advice of the Council of Ministers.
______ is a pointer to the fact that there is no consensus as to the function of the agency.
different classifications
The different classifications is a pointer to the fact that there is no consensus as to the function of the agency.
______ is the process of performing particular acts, of issuing particular orders, or (as usually) of making decisions which apply general rules to particular cases.
Execution
Execution is the process of performing particular acts, of issuing particular orders, or (as usually) of making decisions which apply general rules to particular cases.

______ is the machinery that Government uses to render services to the people and as such, public servants should think of how they can constantly and conveniently improve themselves to give better service.
public service

The public service is the machinery that Government uses to render services to the people and as such, public servants should think of how they can constantly and conveniently improve themselves to give better service.
______ are the agencies of government vested with the powers to legislate on the matters which ordinarily falls within the legislative powers of the legislatures.
Administrative Institutions
Administrative Institutions are the agencies of government vested with the powers to legislate on the matters which ordinarily falls within the legislative powers of the legislatures.
